Chez l'un de nos clients à Neuchâtel et placé sous l'autorité directe du Chef de Secteur, nous sommes à la recherche d'un.e technicien.ne CVC à 100%. Technicien CVC (H/F)
 Dans le cadre de vos missions, vous intervenez sur des sites industriels, tertiaires et hôteliers pour assurer :

• La maintenance préventive et curative, le dépannage et les réparations des installations relevant des contrats qui vous sont confiés;

• L'entretien des équipements CVC : groupes froids, systèmes à détente directe (Split, multi, VRV), ventilo-convecteurs, monoblocs, tours de refroidissement;

• La détection et le signalement des dysfonctionnements, notamment ceux liés à la consommation énergétique, dans une logique de transition énergétique;

• Le suivi administratif rigoureux de vos interventions via la GMAO;

• Des interventions sur site, y compris dans le cadre du service d'astreinte;

• Le traitement des non-conformités sur les installations dont vous avez la charge;

• Le respect strict des règles d'hygiène et de sécurité, en garantissant la sécurité des installations et des personnes.
 Ce qui vous caractérise
 Vous êtes issu(e) d'une formation technique dans le domaine du CVC (CFC ou équivalent)
Vous disposez de solides compétences en CVC, ainsi qu'en aéraulique et hydraulique

• Vous êtes habilité(e) à manipuler les fluides frigorigènes, conformément à la réglementation en vigueur;

• Vous justifiez d'au moins 5 ans d'expérience dans une fonction similaire, idéalement en environnement industriel;

• Vous faites preuve d'un bon esprit d'équipe, tout en étant capable de travailler de manière autonome;

• Vous avez un excellent sens du service et un bon relationnel client.
 Voici ce que nous vous offrons

• Programme de formation interne

• Financement de diverses formations

• Bonnes prestations sociales

• Manutenzione preventiva e curativa, risoluzione dei problemi e riparazioni alle strutture sotto i vostri contratti;

• Manutenzione di apparecchiature HVAC: unità a freddo, sistemi con rilascio diretto (Split, multi, VRV), ventilatori, singoli blocchi, torri di raffreddamento;

• Rilevamento e segnalazione di malfunzionamenti, compresi quelli relativi al consumo energetico, in una logica di transizione energetica;

• Il rigoroso monitoraggio amministrativo dei vostri interventi tramite il GMAO;

• Interventi in loco, anche nell'ambito del servizio di pagamento penale;

• Elaborazione di non conformità alle strutture di cui sei responsabile;

• Il rigoroso rispetto delle norme igieniche e di sicurezza, garantendo la sicurezza degli impianti e delle persone.
 Cosa ti caratterizza
 Hai ricevuto una formazione tecnica nel campo del CVC (CFC o equivalente)
Hai forti competenze CVC, così come le abilità aeree e idrauliche

• L'utente è autorizzato a gestire fluidi refrigeranti in conformità alle normative vigenti;

• Hai almeno 5 anni di esperienza in una funzione simile, idealmente nell'ambiente industriale;

• Hai un buon spirito di squadra, pur essendo in grado di lavorare indipendentemente;

• Hai un ottimo senso di servizio e una buona relazione con i clienti.
 Ecco cosa ti offriamo

descriptionByLocale.en:
At one of our clients in Neuchâtel and under the direct authority of the Head of Sector, we are looking for a 100% CCV technician. CCV Technician (H/F)
 As part of your missions, you intervene on industrial, tertiary and hotel sites to ensure:

• Preventive and curative maintenance, troubleshooting and repairs to the facilities under your contracts;

• Maintenance of HVAC equipment: cold units, systems with direct release (Split, multi, VRV), fan-convectors, single blocks, cooling towers;

• Detection and reporting of malfunctions, including those related to energy consumption, in a logic of energy transition;

• The rigorous administrative monitoring of your interventions via the GMAO;

• On-site interventions, including as part of the periodic penalty payment service;

• Processing of non-compliances on the facilities you are responsible for;

• The strict observance of hygiene and safety rules, ensuring the safety of installations and persons.
 What characterises you
 You have received technical training in the field of CVC (CFC or equivalent)
You have strong CVC skills, as well as air and hydraulic skills

• You are authorized to handle refrigerant fluids in accordance with applicable regulations;

• You have at least 5 years of experience in a similar function, ideally in the industrial environment;

• You have a good team spirit, while being able to work independently;

• You have an excellent sense of service and a good customer relationship.
 Here's what we offer you

• Internal training programme

• Funding for various training courses

• Good social benefits
 Equals
 As the leading provider of global solutions for building and energy in Switzerland, we support the transformation and digitisation of our customers and work together on the energy transition.

Our services cover the entire life cycle of buildings, sites, infrastructure and neighbourhoods. As a market leader, our customers benefit from a full range of services from a single point of contact as well as solutions to their projects developed in an integrated and team-based manner.

We have a presence throughout Switzerland and employ 6500 people spread over 140 sites. This enables us to effectively implement both regional and country-wide projects.

In addition to building automation and technology as well as Facility Management, our offer also includes specializations such as energy supply, transport, telecommunications, digitisation and energy optimization. We design, build and implement projects that extend from intelligent buildings to future power plants through tunnels.
